messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Rosuvastatin (Crestor) is a prescription medicine.
The medicine is used to treat high cholesterol.
The medicine is used to reduce the risk of major cardiovascular events.
Major cardiovascular events include heart attack and stroke.
Rosuvastatin belongs to a class of medicines called statins.
Rosuvastatin works by blocking HMG-CoA reductase.
HMG-CoA reductase is the rate-limiting enzyme the liver uses to make cholesterol.
With cholesterol synthesis reduced, the liver increases its LDL receptors.
The liver clears more LDL from the blood.
LDL is "bad" cholesterol.
LDL and total cholesterol levels fall.
The maximum reduction is usually reached by four weeks.
Rosuvastatin comes as a tablet.
Rosuvastatin was first approved by the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) on August 12, 2003, under the brand name Crestor.
Many generic versions of rosuvastatin tablets have since been approved.
Triplet: ["Rosuvastatin", "has generic version", "generic versions of rosuvastatin tablets"]

The relation 'has generic version' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug has generic versions of the dosage form specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has dosage form': The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
B. 'has generic name': The subject drug is sold under or known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
C. 'has recommended dose': The subject drug is typically prescribed at the dose or dosing regimen specified by the object entity.
D. 'has multiple brands and forms': The subject drug is available in multiple brands and forms as specified by the object entity.
E. 'belongs to drug class': The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological or therapeutic drug class specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
